NewsArticle.Title: Mileth Fair: Tournaments
NewsArticle.Content: .01.09 Dartanian Lestor, Aisling and longstanding organizer in Mileth, writes of the first Aisling-hosted fair, hosted by Mileth Village: Mileth Festival: Registration and Sign-ups - Tournaments Tournaments- Contact Pasha for any questions and/or interest in any of these events. Sumo-to be held once per Temuairan week of the festival Entry fee: 4,000 gold for early sign-up/8,000 gold for on-the-spot registration. We need 16 people with throw to participate in this event. We also need 3 judges. The entry fees will be pooled and at the end of the tournament, 3/4ths of the pool shall go to the winner and 1/4th shall go to the runner-up. Sign up now will result in a reduced cost. If slots are open at the time of the tournament, the cost is raised but participation is still a possibility (this is so if ye want ye can observe it first) Throwing relay-to be held twice per Temuairan week the tournament is open. Fee: 10,000 gold per team We need 2 judges for this event. As well, we need 4 participants in each team and 4 teams for a total of 16 aislings. At least 3 members per team need to have learned throw. Sign up is required for this. Winners will get a prize purse distributed among the members of the team. Running Relay- to be held two times per Temuairan week of the festival Fee: 4,000 gold per team We need 4 judges for this event (one for each corner). Also there will be 4 teams consisting of 3 aislings each so 12 in total. Any can participate in this event. As with the throwing relay, the prize money will be distributed among the winners. Sign up is required for this as well. Wolf's Bane- to be held 3 times per Temuairan week Fee: 2,500 per participant. We need 5 judges for this event. We will also need 6-8 participants each time. No sign up is required for this event, it is on a first come, first serve basis. The participants in this aren't to be carrying any other items while participating. Monster Battling Tournament- to be held once per Temuairan week Entry Fee: 50,000 coins per monster We need at least one judge for each tournament. Battles are held at a first come/first serve basis. No sign-up is required. No monsters that cannot be controlled by the summoner to some extent shall be allowed. The participants are not allowed to attack either monster after the initial strike to initiate combat. Again, see Pasha for details on these events.
